name: Eldritch Blast

cantrip_scaling.text: Two beams at character level 5, three at level 11 and four at level 17; each beam is its own attack roll.

summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 Force; two beams at level 5, three at 11, four at 17.
text: You loose a beam of crackling force at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d10 Force damage. The spell fires more beams as you gain levels: two at character level 5, three at level 11 and four at level 17. Each beam gets its own attack roll, and you can send them all at one target or split them among several.
